title: Nature and exploration
learning_outcomes: Explain nature and evidence in the context of nature and exploration.
Compare and distinguish safety and access in the context of nature and exploration.
Apply environmental impact in the context of nature and exploration.
Evaluate and justify decisions about enjoyment in the context of nature and exploration.

lessons.title: Nature and evidence
lessons.outcome: Explain nature and evidence in the context of nature and exploration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving nature and evidence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to accessible nature plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain nature and evidence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of nature and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Safety and access
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish safety and access in the context of nature and exploration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving safety and access; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to accessible nature plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain safety and access from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of safety and access; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Environmental impact
lessons.outcome: Apply environmental impact in the context of nature and exploration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving environmental impact; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to accessible nature plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain environmental impact from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of environmental impact; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Enjoyment
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about enjoyment in the context of nature and exploration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving enjoyment; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to accessible nature plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain enjoyment from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of enjoyment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of nature and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of safety and access; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of environmental impact; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of enjoyment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
